d: Silver Sands Beach is seeking a welcoming and service-focused Front Desk Agent to support a smooth, enjoyable experience for guests and members. Based in Jeddah, this role is the first point of contact at the front desk and helps with inquiries, check-ins, reservations, and day-to-day guest needs.
Welcome guests and members warmly and professionally.
Manage arrivals, check-ins, registrations, and related front desk procedures.
Respond to questions about the beach, facilities, services, opening hours, and policies.
Handle reservations and bookings, and keep guest information and records accurate.
Answer phone calls and direct inquiries to the appropriate team.
Coordinate with other departments to resolve guest requests promptly.
Address concerns courteously and escalate issues when needed.
Process payments or transactions in line with company procedures.
Keep the front desk organized and maintain a professional reception area.
Follow company service standards, safety procedures, and applicable local requirements.
Previous experience in a front desk, reception, hospitality, or customer service role is preferred.
A friendly, professional manner and a genuine interest in guest service.
Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple requests in a busy environment.
Comfortable using booking systems, point-of-sale systems, and basic computer applications.
Fluent Arabic and good English communication skills are preferred.
Reliable, punctual, and able to work shifts, including weekends and public holidays as required.
We are looking for Human Resources Specialist to join our team at Riyadh.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources or a related field.
3–5 years of relevant experience in HR.

d: Assist the Business unit managers in critical positions and ensure timely closing of vacancies to help optimize work efficiency.
Preparation of Demand letter /Job Order / Recruitment Agency Agreement and related documents required for processing recruitment function.
Receive Recruitment Request from business units for requested positions and check details for position specifications to initiate process of recruitment.
Source CVs for requested positions by using recruitment method such as walk in, job portals, social media, recruitment agencies etc. to match position requirements with candidate profile.
Conduct shortlisting of candidates through telephone screening to confirm suitability of candidates to requested position and advise business units on the outcome of shortlisting.

Check candidate documents for compliance to company policies and Government regulations and forward to business unit for approval, schedule technical interview with business units and follow up on feedback.
Initiate process of employee mobilization upon receiving approved Hiring Request by the business unit.

Prepare job offers and follow up with Payroll and Personnel sections for transfer of residency process respectively for local hires till joining and update business units on continuing basis on the joining status of the candidate.
Coordinate with recruitment agencies for overseas recruitment for communication on position requirements, scheduling of interviews and trade tests, preparation of contract letters etc .
Accompany business unit Managers to overseas locations for recruitment trips, update Manager, HR on status of recruitment on daily basis by sending recruitment report.
Coordinate with Personnel section for issuance of work visa for overseas recruits, attestation of necessary documents by Government bodies.
Following up on joining formalities and update business units on continuing basis on the joining status of the candidates.

Complete joining formalities by preparing necessary documents and coordinate with Training section for orientation training of new joiners, coordinating with respective department for employee accommodation and airport pick up arrangements for overseas candidates, hand over employee documents to filing section to ensure safe custody.
Perform any other duty requested by the Team Leader.
The position is responsible for generating sales and deliver customer service at its best.
Support the other operational duties such as housekeeping, visual presentation standards, etc. as assigned by the Store Management Team.

Provides important visual cues for guests that make a positive first impression E.g. wearing proper career wear that is clean and neatly pressed, maintaining a clean parking lot/exterior and a clean and inviting dining room.
Follows the guaranteed Always Fresh procedure to ensure coffee and products are always fresh and always accurate.
Delivers consistent and outstanding guest service through friendly attitude, attentive behavior and strong product knowledge.
Enhances the guest experience by following the S.E.T. Principles: Smile, Eye Contact, Thank You.
Uses proper procedures to ensure the accuracy of every order for every guest.
Ensures every guest receives a prompt and warm greeting within 5 seconds at front counter and drive-thru.
Maintains speed of service targets by working efficiently with a sense of urgency to fill orders and meet guests’ needs.
Promptly executes service recovery for any guest concerns or complaints by making it right with the guest, regardless of involvement in the issue.
Listens carefully to guests and apologizes for the experience in the case of a complaint. Store Operations
Follows all Operations standards and guidelines for preparation of products according to training and instructional materials provided.
Prepares all products as required, following the order monitor to ensure the accuracy of every order.
Communicates showcase and product needs to ensure proper product availability for guests.
Regularly takes temperatures of the required products and records in the Time & Temperature Log. Policies and Procedures
Participates in and attends all store meetings and other related functions.
Follows all restaurant policies, procedures and standards.
Maintains the front counter by keeping it clean, organized, stocked and ready for rush periods in the restaurant.
Follows proper hand washing techniques and all sanitation guidelines; completes all sanitation tasks as outlined by the Store Manager. Cashiering
Receives payment by cash, credit cards, vouchers or automatic debits.
Issue receipts, refunds, or change to the customers correctly.
Count money in the cash till at the beginning of the shifts to ensure that amount is correct and there is adequate change.
Maintain clean and orderly checkout areas. Health & Safety
Works in compliance with occupational health and safety legislation.
Knows, understands and follows safe work practices and procedures.
Uses or wears personal protective equipment or clothing as required.

Reports all injuries/illnesses, accidents, unsafe conditions, security incidents and any contravention of health and safety legislation, policies and procedures to the Restaurant Manager or Restaurant Owner.
Does not operate any equipment, machine, device or thing, or otherwise work in a manner that will endanger anyone.
